question: Does source-population calibration of marginal locations improve downstream use of a frozen virtual biomarker generator?
scope: Same-evidence paired mechanism screen; not new model training, full framework superiority, or a novel-statistics claim

target.eligibility: Valid observed age/sex, finite positive BMI and phlebotomy weight, finite measured HbA1c for evaluation eligibility only; no selection on HbA1c magnitude or diagnosis
target.freshness: New endpoint evaluation after bounded project audit; survey and some participants/covariates previously used for other outcomes, not an entirely new cohort
target.public_metadata_exposure: Custodian saw official codebook public frequency/range sections before filtered metadata access; no such values sent to builders or used for calibration

family_origin: Two inherited Agent-authored M10 structures; not two new independent LLM constructions
scientific_change: Only sex-specific location parameters may change through source-only calibration. Within each family generator code, age/BMI response and residual structure stay fixed. Source scientist defines primary and two alternative source-covariate scenarios before feedback.
information_contrast: Same admitted source packet and context scenarios in both initial and calibrated arms; source packet expands M10 evidence but is shared in M11
calibration: Generic additive-location calibration using actual frozen source outputs and pooled three-seed source medians by sex; published marginal medians are constraints rather than automatically conditional locations. Check actual replay after adjustment, preserve all failures and scenarios. Clipping/nontranslation must be checked, not assumed away.

estimation.target_quantile: Left inverse weighted empirical CDF with ties aggregated; identical real/generated estimator
estimation.regression: Weighted least squares HbA1c on intercept, age/10, BMI/5, and female indicator
estimation.errors: HbA1c percentage points; equal average over the two sex median errors and six cell mean errors; missing cells retained as unassessed, not silently omitted
estimation.uncertainty: Descriptive point estimates and residual ranges only; no clinical equivalence claim, survey confidence interval or seed-based significance test

decision_rule.primary_direction: For each family, compare every paired seed's calibrated_primary sex-median MAE against initial. All three decreases is consistent improvement within that family, not independent replication or clinical equivalence. Retain magnitude and mixed outcomes.
decision_rule.sensitivity: Report all alternative-source scenarios; shared improvement is robustness within these chosen assumptions, not posterior probability
decision_rule.reuse: Report cell-mean and Q90 changes independently; primary improvement does not imply reusable improvement
decision_rule.preservation: Sex-specific additive offsets should leave age/BMI WLS slopes unchanged absent clipping; test numerical difference against 1e-10 as an implementation identity, not a clinical tolerance
decision_rule.stop: After fixed scenarios and seeds, no target-informed revision. Source improvement without target improvement is a negative transfer result, not a reason to retune the revealed target.

release_rule: Bind protocol, scenario plan, source-admission records, evaluator, visible inputs, sealed reference hash, all candidate freezes and all 24 successful generation receipts before the evaluator opens/parses the sealed reference or computes any target statistics. Prior authorized custodian parsing solely for preparation/eligibility is documented separately. Builders never receive target feedback during construction.
limits: Source covariate distributions remain approximations; same-cohort source papers are not independent evidence
One new endpoint/survey cycle is a diagnostic screen
Preservation is partially mathematical by construction
Residual draws do not estimate source, structure or transport uncertainty
Only generator process is OS isolated; Agent file access is procedurally restricted
No participant-level tables are to be uploaded to GitHub
